summary: SSE session resumes lose trailing sentences after corporate VPN split-tunnel network switch
description: Issue summary: Customer reports intermittent streaming responses ending without the final sentences (trailing fragment missing) when users reconnect while on corporate VPN with split-tunnel enabled. Impact: Several users at FinEdge see generated answers cut off mid-paragraph after network path migration (VPN split-tunnel toggle or mobile data fallback). This causes incorrect/partial content to land in production UIs. Environment: prod-us-east, corporate VPN egress (split-tunnel), client apps on iOS and Android behind corporate policy.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Connect mobile device through corporate VPN with split-tunnel enabled (crypto company profile used at FinEdge).
2) Start a long-running SSE generation request (>10s output) against /v1/generate with stream=true using the customer's API key and redwood-1.2 model,
3) While SSE stream is active, trigger a network path migration: enable/disable split-tunnel or force background to foreground wifi->cell handoff,
4) Observe reconnect/resume behavior from client: sometimes the stream resumes but final 1-3 sentences are missing or truncated and metadata at end is duplicated or interleaved.

Expected: resume produces a full finalization event and a complete final paragraph; actual: trailing sentences or terminal JSON metadata missing in 10-30% of reproductions under customer's corp network conditions.

investigation_notes: 2026-03-10: Initial triage by Support: reproduced with FinEdge config on test device using the customer's VPN profile. Failures clustered around client-side IP change (split-tunnel rebind) and token refresh window.

Observed pattern: original socket inbound from corporate egress IP A, after path migration new socket observed from public IP B; ALB routed to a different worker instance which rejected exact resume offset and fell back to partial-stream semantics.

Root hypothesis: combination of (1) ephemeral token reissue during auth refresh, (2) ALB worker affinity flip due to IP change, and (3) strict resume-offset enforcement + KV cache sharding produced a failure mode where the runtime could not stitch final kv-primed tokens and therefore skipped finalization metadata.
Reproducer: deterministic when offset distribution exceeds 1600 tokens and resume occurs within the 2s auth-refresh window; intermittent outside of that window.
Cross-checks: compared with SUP-274311 which discusses session drift on network migration; similar but here resume outcome is missing trailing sentences rather than duplicated prefixes.
Telemetry: added temporary debug logs to workers to capture resume-offset and kv-cache lookups (PR linked).

resolution_notes: Root cause: resume flow failed when a network path migration (split-tunnel VPN) led to IP change + auth token refresh and ALB routing to a worker without the required KV primed cache. The runtime previously required an exact resume offset match; when KV was missing it entered partial-stream mode and finalization metadata could be suppressed. Fixes applied: (1) runtime patch to allow small resume offset rebase and attempt KV rehydration from durable snapshot, (2) ALB stickiness TTL increased for SSE endpoints, (3) monitoring alert added for resume-offset-mismatch rate >0.5% per minute, (4) customer-facing guidance to avoid toggling split-tunnel during active streams. Patch deployed to prod-us-east on 2026-03-12 02:00 UTC (serving-runtime PR #1892). Customer validated in 48h smoke test. Follow-ups: add e2e test for path migration resume and add documentation to runbook.
